paths.name: @/lib/prisma
paths.message: The raw Prisma client sees every school's data. Use getScopedDb(user.schoolId, user.id) from '@/lib/scoped-db'. Only code under lib/ may import the raw client.

paths.name: @prisma/client
paths.message: Do not create a raw Prisma client. Use getScopedDb(user.schoolId, user.id) from '@/lib/scoped-db'.

patterns.message: The raw Prisma client sees every school's data. Use getScopedDb from '@/lib/scoped-db'.
